jobs.title: Environmental Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a talented  Environmental Strategy Manager  to join our  team  in  Environment  for Cummins  Daventry, Northamptonshire, United Kingdom.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

-
Lead regulatory sensing and analysis for assigned environmental and product non-emissions regulatory areas, interpreting complex technical, legal, and regulatory documents and translating requirements into clear guidance for the business.

-
Anticipate emerging regulatory developments, assess their technical, commercial, and strategic impacts, and provide actionable recommendations to leaders, technical experts, and product teams to manage risks and opportunities.

-
Develop and lead company regulatory positions and advocacy strategies, defining engagement objectives, timelines, key messages, external partners, and actions required to influence emerging environmental and product regulations.

-
Lead cross-functional regulatory advocacy programs from inception through completion, partnering with Engineering, Compliance, Product, Legal, Government Relations, and other stakeholders to align positions and deliver agreed regulatory outcomes.

-
Build and maintain effective relationships with regulators, industry associations, customers, and other external stakeholders, representing company interests and communicating constructively across global markets and diverse audiences.

-
Develop and communicate regulatory intelligence, strategic recommendations, educational materials, and unified regulatory messages to internal stakeholders, ensuring complex environmental and regulatory topics are clearly understood.

-
Develop strategic frameworks and analyses that synthesize environmental data, stakeholder input, regulatory trends, risks, and opportunities to support business strategy, product planning, compliance activities, and informed decision-making.

-
Manage multiple cross-functional regulatory projects and continuous improvement initiatives, including project scope, timelines, risks, resources, tools, and processes, while identifying process gaps, implementing improvement plans, and sharing lessons learned across teams.
Education/ Experience:
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Environmental Policy, Law, Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Environmental Science, Business, or a related technical or scientific discipline; a Master’s or other advanced degree is preferred, with legal training or a legal background strongly preferred.
- Demonstrated experience in environmental and/or regulatory policy, with a strong understanding of emerging product regulatory requirements and their implications for business and product strategies.
- Proven experience leading global initiatives and cross-functional teams, working effectively across organizational boundaries and with internal and external stakeholders to deliver strategic regulatory outcomes.
- Experience engaging with EU policymakers, trade associations, and industry groups is strongly preferred; previous experience in government, a trade association, or strategic regulatory development is an advantage.
- Working knowledge of major EU materials and product regulatory frameworks, including EU POPs, REACH, RoHS, WEEE, ESPR, and the EU Battery Regulation, with experience partnering with in-house counsel to assess emerging product regulatory risks.
To be successful in this role you will need the following:

- Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional subject matter expert teams and projects, independently coordinating internal and external initiatives across organizational boundaries to achieve shared objectives.
- Strong environmental acumen, with knowledge of environmental topics and trends related to air, exhaust, water, waste, sustainability, and/or materials, and the ability to assess environmental data and business impacts.
- Strong strategic and analytical thinking skills, with the ability to interpret complex and sometimes contradictory information, conduct gap analyses, benchmark current and desired states, and develop actionable recommendations and strategies.
- Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build partnerships, communicate effectively across organizational boundaries, and establish trust through integrity, authenticity, and transparent engagement.
- Strong planning, project, and risk management skills, with the ability to prioritize work, manage project issues and risks, establish timelines, and deliver commitments aligned with organizational goals.
- Ability to develop and improve systems and processes, using structured approaches to eliminate inefficiencies, address roadblocks, document workflows, and implement sustainable solutions that improve organizational effectiveness.
Leads processes to determine discipline positions on strategic environmental and business priorities and leads and internal and external stakeholder engagement. Manages, develops, and implements programs composed of multiple cross functional projects. Partners with key business stakeholders to ensure a successful project completion. Manages the design, development and implementation of tools and processes which facilitates the achievement of functional excellence. Partners with discipline leadership to identify process gaps, and develops improvement plans. Coordinates and monitors the execution of the improvement projects for a given area.

jobs.title: Corporate Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced strategy professional to help shape the strategic direction of Cummins’ Distribution Business across Asia Pacific. This newly created regional role will work closely with senior leaders on some of the business’s most important growth, profitability and transformation priorities – from framing complex strategic questions through to recommendations and execution.

The role offers exposure across markets, businesses and senior leadership, with the flexibility to be based in any Australian capital city or Singapore.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

-
Lead high-impact strategic initiatives and workstreams across business units, growth opportunities and new ventures

-
Develop business strategies using qualitative and quantitative analysis to evaluate opportunities, challenges and potential solutions

-
Generate strategic insights from market, financial, environmental, stakeholder and business data to support decision-making

-
Partner with senior regional and global leaders and key stakeholders to influence strategic direction and outcomes

-
Lead cross-functional initiatives, resolving complex challenges and driving strategic priorities through to execution

-
Communicate complex strategic concepts and recommendations clearly through compelling written and verbal presentations

-
Lead through influence, providing strategic guidance on complex business challenges while coaching and building capability across project teams
Being part of Cummins means working alongside today’s most innovative thinkers to solve the world’s toughest problems. We are proud to offer learning and development opportunities designed to promote individual performance and spark purpose and trust within our teams. We look to hire the best and then help you to become even better.
To be successful in this role you will need the following:
•    Demonstrated experience solving complex strategic business problems and leading initiatives through to execution
•    Strong strategic thinking, structured problem-solving and analytical capability, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and test hypotheses
•    Strong execution focus, translating strategic analysis and recommendations into tangible business outcomes
•    Proven ability to influence, communicate and present effectively with VP and senior executive-level stakeholders
•    Experience working across countries, functions and diverse stakeholder groups within a complex organisation
•    Corporate strategy, strategy consulting or equivalent strategy-related experience highly regarded, ideally within a similar heavy industrial or B2B environment
•    Master’s degree in Business Administration or equivalent preferred

jobs.title: Corporate Strategy Manager Summer Internship Positions
jobs.description:
In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

Cummins has been an industry leader in the power space for decades, but our industry is changing. Many of the things that have driven success in the past will not be the same things that drive success in the future as the world moves to a more diversified and decarbonized energy landscape. This reality comes with considerable risk as well as unprecedented opportunity.

If you join Cummins’ Corporate Strategy team, you will be at the forefront of Cummins’ transition to a clean energy future. As a Corporate Strategy Manager, you will work directly with senior leaders to develop recommendations for Cummins’ most pressing strategic priorities. You will have ownership initially over an individual workstream and eventually over entire projects with multiple opportunities to directly present your recommendations to Cummins leaders. Previous interns have evaluated growth opportunities in the clean energy space, assessed M&A options, developed supply chain risk mitigation strategies, and so much more.

You will be joining a highly diverse team of similarly driven problem-solvers in the context of an amazing corporate culture that provides a supportive environment and values your work-life balance. Our team heavily focuses on your personal and professional development to propel you to an exciting and fulfilling career at Cummins. Corporate Strategy Managers have gone on to varied and fulfilling careers in Cummins as product managers, commercial leaders, general managers, and strategists.

This is an exciting opportunity in Columbus, Indiana or Indianapolis, Indiana for a Corporate Strategy Manager. The role is hybrid, by which we mean that managers are expected to be present in both locations periodically for stakeholder and team engagement, and work from home is also possible. Interns are expected to be in an office location 3 days/week.
2026 Monthly Salary Range by Degree Level:

- MBA - $9,700.00

Candidates must currently reside within the continental United States. Students are expected to work 40 hours per week for a minimum of 10 weeks and a maximum of 12 weeks.
International Student Eligibility (U.S. based roles):  F-1 visa students must have approved Curricular Practical Training (CPT) or Occupational Practical Training (OPT) before their Early Career assignment begin. CPT/OPT must relate to their degree and be authorized by their university. Students are responsible for securing this approval through their school’s international office.

Cummins and E-verify

Cummins validates right to work using E-Verify. Our culture believes in POWERING YOUR POTENTIAL. We provide global opportunities to develop your career, make your community a better place and work with today’s most innovative thinkers to solve the world’s toughest problems.

jobs.title: IAM Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
Responsible for leading the organization’s cybersecurity operations team, with a primary focus on incident response, threat monitoring, and the execution of cybersecurity strategies, policies, and risk management practices to safeguard the organization’s systems, data, and infrastructure. The manager serves as a coach and mentor to security professionals, builds operational processes aligned with best practices and industry standards, and partners with engineering, IT, and business to protect critical systems, infrastructure, and data from evolving threats. Serves as an accountable leader for the people, processes, and technologies that prevent, detect, investigate, and contain cyber threats across enterprise, cloud, and OT environments. Owns SecOps outcomes (24×7 monitoring & incident response), the detection engineering program (use-case lifecycle, signal quality, automation), and the threat hunting program

Key Responsibilities:
Leads the execution of complex responses to computer security incidents in alignment with organizational policies and industry best practices. Coordinates and communicates with multiple business units during incidents, providing updates and actionable recommendations. Oversees root cause analysis and ensures that lessons learned are integrated into improved processes and protections. Leads teams in assessing severity, developing mitigation strategies, and prioritizing risk reduction activities. Monitors security-related intelligence sources (e.g., SANS, BugTraq) to maintain situational awareness of current attacks and trends. Collaborates with Cybersecurity Engineering teams and business to communicate risks and recommend security enhancements. Ensures that security technologies employed by the operations and incident response teams support and enhance operational processes. Identifies opportunities to improve operational efficiency, standard operating procedures, and incident response playbooks. Leads the application of recognized cybersecurity and IT frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO, ITIL, COBIT) in alignment with organizational processes and controls. Manages, coaches, and mentors cybersecurity operations staff, fostering a culture of learning, accountability, and continuous improvement. Defines team objectives, evaluates performance, and supports professional growth through training and development. Participates in industry task forces and working groups to stay informed on evolving threats and best practices, and fosters a culture of continuous improvement in cybersecurity practices and awareness. Contributes to organizational situational awareness by managing and leveraging cybersecurity data sources.
Primary Function : The IAM Operations Manager is responsible for leading the organization’s IAM operations team across all IAM functions, with a primary focus on incident and problem response, general administration, monitoring, system availability, and compliance tasks. This role will also be responsible for execution of IAM strategies, policies, and risk management practices to safeguard the organization’s systems, data, and infrastructure. Key duties include managing team workflows, enforcing service-level agreements, and running security tools like Saviynt, MS Entra, CyberArk etc.
Core Responsibilities:
- Manage ongoing IAM operations and lead internal and multiple supplier teams in assessing severity, developing mitigation strategies, and prioritizing risk reduction activities

- Oversee maintenance and specific problem resolution. Anticipate, identify, track and resolve technical issues. Oversee delivery assurance, quality, and architectural governance

- Coordinate and communicate with multiple business units and various stakeholders at all levels during incidents. Provide updates and actionable recommendations

- Oversee root cause analysis and ensure that lessons learned are integrated into improved processes and protection

- Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, standard operating procedures, and incident response playbooks. Create and maintain clear, accessible documentation and standardized procedures to ensure consistent practices, traceability, and knowledge sharing across IAM functions

- Establish policies for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), and Access Management (AM).

- Integrate IAM solutions with enterprise applications, cloud platforms, and hybrid IT infrastructures

- Collaborate with stakeholders and business leaders to translate identity requirements into scalable, compliant solutions that are clearly understood

- Work across functions to improve IAM solutions to enhance compliance requirements and best practices
- Manage, coach, and mentor IAM operations staff, fostering a culture of learning, accountability, and continuous improvement
- Define team objectives, evaluate performance, and support professional growth through training and development
- Conduct industry and market research and maintain a working knowledge of technologies and emerging trends in the IAM space
Competencies: Process Management and Optimization - Designs, refines, and automates IT operations processes to improve efficiency, consistency, service quality, security, and cost effectiveness across diverse environments.
Service Quality and Reliability - Ensures IT services consistently meet performance, availability, and user satisfaction expectations by proactively maintaining service integrity, minimizing disruptions, and driving continuous improvement through collaboration, cost-effective practices, and operational excellence.
Risk Management - Proactively identifies, assesses, and mitigates risks to IT services, data, and operations by applying structured controls and communication strategies to strengthen resilience, ensure compliance, and reduce business impact through structured controls, cost-aware decision-making, and communication strategies.
Incident and Problem Management - Responds to disruptions and recurring issues by restoring service quickly, identifying root causes, and applying structured methods to reduce risk, improve reliability, and prevent recurrence.
Standardization and Documentation - Creates and maintains clear, accessible documentation and standardized procedures to ensure consistent practices, traceability, and knowledge sharing across IT environments.
Technical Passion and Drive - Models curiosity and excitement for technology by self-initiating continuous development, experimenting with emerging technologies, and identifying insertion opportunities that accelerate business performance.
Security and Compliance - Applies standards, tools, and best practices to embed security, privacy, and compliance into the design/build/test/operate lifecycle for products, services, apps, systems, software, and configurations—balancing protection, efficiency, and cost.
Driving Effective Outcomes - Takes ownership, acts with urgency, and initiates action to turn goals into clear plans, decisions, guardrails, and cadences while navigating ambiguity and change to drive momentum and deliver consistent results.
Engaging with Impact - Communicates with clarity and purpose to align stakeholders, foster collaboration, build trust, and influence coordinated action across teams and functions to accelerate outcomes.
Values Differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
Ensuring Customer Success - Embraces a customer-first mindset to deliver outcomes by linking customer needs and business priorities to aligned solutions, delivery, adoption, satisfaction, and realized value through sustained engagement that builds partnership and trust.
Managing People and Teams - Builds inclusive teams that empower ownership, deepen capabilities, and ensure fair, timely performance accountability, creating an environment where people can deliver their best work and top performance.
Directs Work - Creates conditions for team success with clear goals, priorities, work plans, standards, effective processes, resourcing, and governance to enable fast, empowered, accountable, and quality execution.
Education, Licenses, Certifications: College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related subject, or relevant equivalent experience required. Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) Security Essentials Certification, GIAC Security Leadership Certification, Information Systems Audit and Control Association (ISACA) Certified Information Security Manager, Microsoft Certified Systems Engineer: Security, or Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) certification preferred. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
Experience: Understanding of the capabilities and configuration of industrial cybersecurity controls and solutions across multiple facets; for example: asset management, vulnerability management, anomaly detection, identity and access management, network security, endpoint security, application security, IDS/IPS, deep packet inspection, SIEM, data analytics, security and/or risk management and product development.
Demonstrated ability to lead teams, manage budgets, and build organizational capability.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence policy and advocate for cybersecurity best practices.
Proven experience in cybersecurity management or equivalent leadership role.

jobs.title: Controller - Operations Finance Manager
jobs.description:
We’re seeking a talented Controller - Operations Finance Manager to join our team specializing in Finance for our York, SC Cummins location.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

- Drive Strategic Business Decisions:  Apply business and marketplace insights to identify opportunities, mitigate risks, and support decisions that advance organizational goals and performance.

- Provide Financial Insights:  Analyze financial trends, variances, opportunities, and risks to deliver actionable recommendations that improve business results and support leadership decision-making.

- Lead Accurate Forecasting and Planning:  Partner with stakeholders to develop reliable forecasts, validate assumptions, and provide forward-looking financial projections aligned with business strategy.

- Build Strong Business Partnerships:  Collaborate across functions to influence decision-making, align stakeholders, and drive solutions that support organizational objectives.

- Ensure Financial Integrity and Compliance:  Maintain the accuracy of financial data, investigate variances, implement corrective actions, and ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations and policies.

- Communicate Complex Information Effectively:  Translate financial data and business insights into clear, meaningful messages tailored to different audiences, enabling informed decision-making at all levels.

- Drive Accountability and Execution:  Prioritize work, remove obstacles, and ensure commitments are met while maintaining a strong focus on results, accuracy, and continuous improvement.

- Develop Inclusive and Adaptable Relationships:  Foster collaboration across diverse teams, adapt to changing business needs, manage challenges effectively, and contribute to a culture of growth, inclusion, and high performance.
- Responsible for the maintaining a strong control environment at York, SC and Manning, SC manufacturing sites
- Partners with plant leadership to ensure goals and strategic objectives are met
- Partners with NA Accounting team on closing the books and balance sheet reviews
- Supports CDBS strategic initiatives with financial data and analysis as requested
- Responsible for coaching and developing 4 direct reports
To be successful in this role you will need the following:
- Lead Plant Financial Performance:  Serve as the finance leader for the York, SC and Manning, SC manufacturing sites, providing financial guidance and insights that support operational and business objectives.
- Build Strong Partnerships and Influence Decisions:  Collaborate closely with plant leadership and the North America Accounting team to achieve strategic goals, support month-end close activities, and ensure sound financial decision-making.
- Maintain Financial Controls and Compliance:  Establish and sustain a strong control environment by ensuring accurate financial reporting, conducting balance sheet reviews, and driving accountability across both sites.
- Develop Talent and Support Growth:  Coach and develop a team of four direct reports while providing financial analysis and support for  Cummins Drivetrain and Braking Systems  strategic initiatives that drive business performance and continuous improvement.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
College, university, or equivalent degree in Accounting, Finance or related field required. Certified Public Accountant, Certified Management Accountant, Chartered Accountant or similar certification required.

Experience:
Significant experience required, including managerial and budgetary experience in a small operations manufacturing or distribution center environment.

jobs.title: Service Transformation Leader
jobs.description:
We are looking for a talented Service Transformation Leader to join our team in Service for Cummins Ireland or UK, in Dublin or any other Cummins office this region close to major Data centers hubs.

Hybrid working schedule, normal working hours with reference to travel up to 50%

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

-
Monitor and optimize service performance by managing key Data Center customer KPIs, analyzing trends, and driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance service delivery and customer satisfaction.

-
Lead cross-functional service escalations across Europe, ensuring timely Root Cause Analysis (RCA), resolution, and clear communication with customers and internal stakeholders throughout the issue lifecycle.

-
Drive service transformation initiatives by streamlining escalation processes, improving collaboration between engineering, service, supply chain, procurement, and other key functions to increase operational efficiency.

-
Manage warranty, vendor, and parts escalations, coordinating resolution activities, internal communications, campaigns, and complex service cases to minimize customer impact.

-
Coordinate strategic service operations by monitoring Data Center strategic parts availability with Supply Chain and facilitating regular collaboration meetings between regional service branches.

-
Act as the primary escalation lead for critical customer issues, ensuring visibility, governance, and effective tracking of RCA performance, escalation metrics, and resolution timelines across Europe.

-
Develop technical expertise and knowledge sharing by building Subject Matter Expert (SME) capability in Balance of Plant (BoP) and Data Center systems, delivering training, best practices, and technical guidance to local service teams and customers.

-
Strengthen stakeholder communication and collaboration by leading customer-facing and internal communications, supporting supplier and packager escalations, and fostering alignment across regional and global teams to improve service outcomes.
Education/ Experience:
- College, university, or equivalent degree in a relevant discipline or relevant experience equivalent required.
- Relevant work experience, including supervisory experience preferred.
To be successful in this role you will need the following:

- Technical expertise in power generation, Data Center, or aftermarket service environments, with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and provide expert service support. Previous Power Generation and/or Data Center experience is preferred.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, service, supply chain, procurement, vendors, and customers. Fluent English is required.
- Experience with service support tools and systems, preferably within Cummins, along with the ability to navigate complex service processes and drive efficient issue resolution.
- Business and financial acumen, with the ability to interpret key financial indicators, evaluate business impacts, and support decisions that improve operational and customer outcomes.
- Proven ability to lead continuous improvement initiatives, demonstrating action orientation, process optimization, and accountability while managing multiple priorities and driving timely results in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to manage complex situations, balance competing priorities, build customer-focused solutions, and effectively navigate cross-functional and organizational dynamics.
Responsible for working cross-functionally to support and transform the service channel, ensuring they utilize the latest technology and provide a world class service to support customers in their territories and deliver strong service business performance.

jobs.title: Placement Student – PowerGen Europe Business Operations
jobs.description:
PLACEMENT STUDENT – PowerGen Europe Business Operations
We are looking for an enthusiastic PowerGen Europe Business Operations Placement Student to join our team specializing in Sales for our Distribution Business Segment in UK, Wellingborough . During your placement with us, you will learn how a major global organization operates, gaining the tools and exposure you will need to become an expert in the industry.
This role is available to candidates who qualify for a placement year and will commence Summer of 2027.
To be successful in this role you will need the following:
- Be working towards a degree that includes a qualifying placement year. Relevant subjects may include Business, Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Marketing, Sales, Finance, Economics, Project Management, Data Analytics or a related discipline.

- Demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to work with a wide range of stakeholders; be able to manage priorities, take ownership and work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

- Have good analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to detail; be comfortable using Microsoft 365 applications; experience with Excel, PowerPoint or data visualization tools would be beneficial.

- Show curiosity, commercial awareness and a willingness to challenge the norm and identify improvements; bring professionalism, sound judgement and a positive, inclusive attitude.

CLOSING DATE: (Thursday, 12 th November 2026 11:59pm)
We have seven Business Operations Placement Student roles available across our Distribution Business Segment in Wellingborough, UK. The roles span the business areas listed below, and successful candidates will be matched to an opportunity that reflects their skills, interests and business needs.
The six roles are available across the following business areas:

jobs.title: VPI Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
Supports program leader(s) to manage, develop, and implement small to medium Value Package Introduction (VPI) program deliverables that meets needs of customer and business.

Key Responsibilities:
Manages Value Package Introduction (VPI) program(s) with small to medium business impact from inception to completion. Manages defining tangible and measurable customer expectations and business outcomes, and supports the program(s) to achieve both. Manages determining the scope, schedule, and resources with key cross functional, cross-Business Units, and external stakeholders, and obtaining stakeholder commitment and approval of the program contract. Ensures adherence of the program(s) to Value Package Introduction (VPI) process. Manages tracking and communicating performance against the program contract with internal stakeholders as appropriate. Manages cross-functional identification and resolution of program risks, and issues. Appropriately escalates risks and issues as needed. Manages cross-functional identification and resolution of program contract changes (scope, schedule, resources). Coaches and develops peer program manager(s). Adopts and shares best practices.
Candidates with experience in the design, manufacturing, or procurement of high-horsepower diesel engines and diesel generator sets will be preferred.
Competencies:

Balances stakeholders - Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.

Builds effective teams - Building strong-identity teams that apply their diverse skills and perspectives to achieve common goals.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Ensures accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

Instills trust - Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Plans and aligns - Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.

Project Issue and Risk Management - Manages the process to identify, assess and prioritize issues and risks using recommended tools and disciplines. Drives actions to minimize, monitor and control risks and issues and to maximize the most positive outcomes possible.

Project Management - Establishes and maintains the balance of scope, schedule and resources for a temporary effort (a “project”). Ensures results/impact from temporary effort are fully realized as possible.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent degree required.
Project Management training and/or experience preferred.
New Product Development training and/or experience preferred.

Experience:

3-5 years of relevant New Product Development experience. Experience with Value Package Introduction (VPI) process preferred.
Supports program leader(s) to manage, develop, and implement small to medium Value Package Introduction (VPI) program deliverables that meets needs of customer and business.
